issues.description: The function ray_sphere_intersect is declared with a different signature in the template header than in the implementation and in the solution header. In template_repository/example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.h the prototype is declared as returning int, while the implementation (template_repository/example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.cpp) and the solution header (solution_repository/example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.h) use bool as the return type. This mismatch is likely an unintended oversight and creates a direct API/semantic mismatch students must resolve (may cause compile errors or confusion about the intended return type).
issues.suggested_fix: Make the declaration in the template header match the implementation and the solution header by changing the prototype in example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.h from 'int ray_sphere_intersect(...)' to 'bool ray_sphere_intersect(...)'. Ensure headers and implementations across template and solution repos use the same return type/signature so students have a consistent API to work with.
